sources.title: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance pricing, figures aggregated via web search summary of third-party partner pricing guides (encorebusiness.com, erpresearch.com); page not fetched directly this session

keyLimits.en: Full user license for finance module only; adding a second app (e.g. Supply Chain Management) costs an additional $30/user/month.
Includes 1,000 Copilot credits per user per month.
Read-only access and basic data entry; same rate for Activity User licenses.

addOns.en: Second app add-on (e.g. Supply Chain Management alongside Finance): +$30/user/month.

cautions.en: As of January 15, 2026, Microsoft began enforcing license compliance: users without the correct license lose access to Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations applications.

Pricing figures were not fetched directly from the official Microsoft pricing page in this session (aggregated from partner/reseller summaries); re-verify against microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics-365/products/finance/pricing.

capabilities.en: Cloud-based financial management covering accounting, cash management and regulatory compliance.
Supply chain integration available as an add-on module alongside Finance.
AI and automation features via Copilot credits on the Premium tier.

limitations.en: Full user licenses are expensive per seat (from $210/user/month), targeting large enterprises rather than small teams.
License enforcement (as of January 2026) means misconfigured licensing can cut off application access.

reason.en: Direct competitor in cloud ERP/finance for mid-size to large organizations.
Major enterprise ERP competitor covering finance and operations.
Cloud financial management alternative, often positioned for mid-market.

unknowns: Official Microsoft pricing page could not be fetched directly in this session; all figures come from third-party partner pricing guides and should be re-verified on microsoft.com.
